description: Cross-references for California Civil Code § 1798.80 et seq. SIM swap carrier liability

cross_references.title: 47 U.S.C. § 222 — CPNI
cross_references.relationship: Federal framework governing carrier CPNI protection. § 1798.81.5 reasonable security standard for California carriers is informed by the federal § 222 CPNI obligations and FCC authentication rules.

cross_references.title: California Penal Code § 502
cross_references.relationship: § 1798.80 civil framework + § 502 computer fraud civil claim are parallel remedies. The § 502 claim covers the unauthorized access; the § 1798.80 claim covers the carrier's failure to prevent it.

cross_references.title: Business & Professions Code § 17200 — UCL
cross_references.relationship: A carrier's failure to implement reasonable security procedures is an 'unlawful' business practice under UCL (predicated on § 1798.81.5 violation) and an 'unfair' practice that harms consumers.

cross_references.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1028 — Federal Identity Theft
cross_references.relationship: SIM swap enabled by carrier's § 1798.81.5 failure is the vehicle for federal identity theft. The carrier's civil liability and the attacker's criminal liability coexist.
